comment: A-priori expectations for the synthetic figure corpus (src-tauri/tests/fixtures/pdf-reflow/figures, drawn by scripts/generate-pdf-reflow-fixtures.mjs at KNOWN user-space coordinates, origin bottom-left y-up). Checked end-to-end by `npm run test:figures` (scripts/diagnose-pdf-figures.mjs --fixtures) through the pure checker scripts/figure-expectations.mjs. Regions are the tight drawn-ink rectangles (axis labels count as chart ink); bbox format [x0,y0,x1,y1]. Intentional pipeline changes that move these numbers MUST update this file in the same PR (same protocol as scripts/perf-baselines.json).

regions.note: nested boxes + arrows + internal labels, tight ink
axes x=140..520 y=380..570 union the 'Load' y-axis label at x=90 (axis labels are chart ink; the detector includes them)
triangle + diagonal, low ink density still detected as figure
figure confined to the right column (columns x 72..296 / 316..540)
spans both columns edge to edge

top figure pair (90,560)-(300,690) + (330,560)-(540,690): adjacent same-band figures merge into ONE analyzer block whose crop legitimately covers the band plus gap, so the crop aspect is not either figure's aspect
drawn figure on the /Rotate 90 page; crop aspect must be the INVERTED drawn aspect (rotation-aware crop math)
19.5:1 wide banner: at this sliver ratio one caption line of bbox bleed moves the crop aspect ~45%, so aspect is not asserted; position/coverage are
1:9.75 tall strip carries the extreme-aspect crop-aspect guarantee

8:1 wide banner, clear vertical whitespace, caption tucked under the bottom edge so caption-bleed cannot legitimately move the aspect — the WIDE extreme-aspect crop-aspect guarantee (fig10's 19.5:1 banner opted out)
